row:
Welcome to Mindful Massage Academy – where massage therapists grow with purpose, presence, and practical skill.

I’m Lindsay, a massage educator, mentor, and bodyworker with a passion for helping therapists build strong hands, smart businesses, and sustainable careers. This channel is your home for hands-on massage tutorials, anatomy-based techniques, self-care strategies, and honest conversations about life in the massage world.

Whether you’re a new massage therapist or an experienced bodyworker ready to deepen your craft, you’re in the right place.

Subscribe for weekly videos on:
	•	Massage techniques & body mechanics
	•	Nervous-system-informed client work
	•	Anatomy, assessment, & touch skills
	•	Burnout prevention & business tips
	•	Embodied support for thriving therapists

Let’s make this work feel good — for your clients and for you.
